items.title: How BMW builds toward Industry AI on Amazon SageMaker AI
items.summary: BMW Group is building toward Industry AI on Amazon SageMaker AI by fine-tuning task-specific LoRA adapters on engineering process data and serving multiple domain capabilities from a single endpoint. Large language models (LLMs) produce convincing output on general tasks, but company-internal engineering processes, proprietary taxonomies, and domain-specific quality standards aren’t represented in public training corpora. Prompting with rules and examples doesn’t reliably close this gap when a task imposes many hard constraints simultaneously because the model has no training signal telling it which constraints are inviolable. In this post, we describe the architecture, walk through the results, and present a repeatable framework you can apply to your own domain.
items.creator: Chris George
